$comment: Weekly live API smoke table (#2600). One row per funded provider; the row
name is the job name and the commit-status context, so the checks tab
explains itself. key_env is the NAME of the environment variable the
workflow injects the repository secret into — never a credential value;
nothing in this file is a secret. Adding a provider is a row plus a
repository secret of that name, never a workflow edit. A row whose
variable is empty reports a visible skip notice and a pending commit
protocol selects which of lintro's own API providers drives the call:
'anthropic' and 'openai' are the two wire protocols lintro implements, and
gateways (kimi, z.ai) reuse them through base_url.
max_tokens is optional (default 16, at most 4096). kimi-k3 and glm-5.3-flash
always reason before answering and spend the cap on that first; at 16
they return a reasoning block and no text, which reads as an empty
